claim.text: Microsoft describes AMORDEGRC as deprecated and included only for compatibility with old workbooks. Formula Atlas marks the function deprecated-legacy and states that it is retained for old-workbook compatibility; this catalog wording accurately reflects Microsoft’s page.
claim.subject_definition: AMORDEGRC availability and deprecation metadata in Formula Atlas

source.excerpt: Microsoft says AMORDEGRC is deprecated and should no longer be used because of changes to French accounting depreciation; it is included for compatibility of old workbooks only. The page also describes its coefficient-based relation to AMORLINC.
source.scope: Public page retrieved 2026-09-24: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/amordegrc-function. This assessment is limited to the deprecation/status wording, not local numerical compatibility.
